issue.title: Show closed-bead attachment in restart previews

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a read-only hint to the ,x restart surface and sase agent restart preview that a currently closed bead will be attached without reopening; preserve bead=, existing restart confirmation rules, and unknown/unreadable fallback. Source review at f3087c86ac: build_restart_preview in src/sase/agent/_restart_preview.py shows bead ID but never reads its close state, and _preview_warnings has only live/changes/home warnings. Use the shared bead read backend and keep display code in Python/TUI. Test open, closed, and unreadable states. No confirmation modal or reopen behavior is requested.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: sase-1li R4 supplies the executing agent with a host notice; the operator preview hint was explicitly deferred in the approved plan and phase sase-1li.3 note #2. Bounded medium work across the existing CLI and TUI preview surfaces.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1li.3 note #2 and explicitly excluded from the closed-bead attach implementation. Operators should see the attach disposition before resubmitting an already closed bead.
